body.fontFamily: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif

label.fontFamily: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: shadow-overlay: dialogs, sheets, popovers, and dropdown menus only. Panels, cards, and the topbar are flat.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, selection, and state feedback only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable nonessential transitions for users who request reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for save, create, submit, approve, or workflow-forward actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #1E4F94; color: #FFFFFF; font: 500 14px/1.5714 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #173E76; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10858D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action for filters, navigation-adjacent actions, and lower-priority commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #D7DEE8; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B1D35; font: 500 14px/1.5714 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #EBF0F7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10858D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard form input for asset, employee, location, search, and settings fields.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0B1D35; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5714; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; height: 40px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #7C8BA0; border-radius: 8px; background: #F6F8FB; color: #0B1D35; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5714 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #3C4F6B; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #10858D; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #10858D; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #E9EEF5; color: #3C4F6B; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Content Panel
components.description: Default grouped surface for forms, dashboard modules, settings sections, and operational content. Flat: separated from the canvas by surface color and border, no shadow.
components.html:
Asset custody

Review current custodian, branch, department, and audit trail context.
components.css: .ds-panel { min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid #D7DEE8; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B1D35; padding: 16px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel-copy { margin: 4px 0 0; max-width: 72ch; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5714; color: #3C4F6B; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: One StatusBadge in two tiers with shape-coded markers. Calm tier (info ring, success/primary dot, neutral bar): no fill or side padding, muted-foreground text. Attention tier (warning triangle, danger diamond): soft fill, border, and tone ink. Every badge carries a text label; database status colors are not shown.
components.html: เปิด รอตรวจสอบ
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 0; background: transparent; color: #3C4F6B; font: 500 14px/1.5714 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-marker { flex: 0 0 auto; forced-color-adjust: none; } .ds-status-info .ds-status-marker { width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 1.5px solid #0A6E75; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-status-success .ds-status-marker { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1D7A35; } .ds-status-primary .ds-status-marker { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1E4F94; } .ds-status-neutral .ds-status-marker { width: 7px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: #3C4F6B; } .ds-status-warning { padding: 4px 10px; background: #FDF4E4; border-color: #EDCB93; color: #A14A05; } .ds-status-warning .ds-status-marker { width: 8px; height: 7px; background: #A14A05; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-status-danger { padding: 4px 10px; background: #FCEFEE; border-color: #F1BEB9; color: #B3261E; } .ds-status-danger .ds-status-marker { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 1px; background: #B3261E; transform: rotate(45deg); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: RBAC-filtered row in the white sidebar (three sections with headings). Inset rounded row, sidebar-muted icon, Sidebar Hover; the active row is solid navy with white text, a teal icon, and aria-current; its focus ring sits outside the row on white.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { min-height: 36px; margin: 0 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1F3657; text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1.5714 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: 0 0 auto; color: #586A84; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #EBF0F7; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10858D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-active, .ds-nav-item-active:hover { background: #083161; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-item-active svg { color: #18A0A8; }

narrative.overview: This visual system should feel like a trusted enterprise record system for asset ownership, custody, audit, maintenance, disposal, reporting, and administration. It is structured, accountable, and operationally reliable. The interface serves real Thai corporate operations, so the design language is calm, corporate, data-driven, and practical.
keyCharacteristics: Dense enough for enterprise scanning, never cramped.
Bordered and tonal by default; only floating layers are lifted.
Status-rich, permission-aware, and readable in Thai and English.
Built for desktop administration and mobile field audit work.

rules.name: The Where Color Lives Rule
rules.body: Navy #083161 lives only in the logo and the selected menu row. Actions and links use Primary #1E4F94. Teal is for info status, the focus ring (#10858D) and the selected menu icon. Green, orange and red appear only inside status badges. Until phase 2, info notices, role chips and a few info icons also use the info tokens and so appear teal.

rules.name: The Status With Evidence Rule
rules.body: Status cues must never rely on color alone. Pair semantic color with readable labels, marker shapes, consistent tone mapping, and visible workflow context.

rules.name: The No Decorative Gradient Rule
rules.body: Decorative gradients are prohibited. The product should feel like an enterprise operations system, not a landing page.

rules.name: The Token Contrast Rule
rules.body: Status text uses the status ink (text-success, text-warning, text-danger, text-info) on white, the page background, muted, or its own soft surface (bg-{tone}-soft). Never tint with opacity (bg-warning/10, bg-primary/10) and never lighten solid fills on hover (/90): use bg-{tone}-soft and hover:bg-{tone}-hover. tests/design-tokens-contrast.test.ts enforces every pair at 4.5:1.

rules.name: The No Display Labels Rule
rules.body: Never use display fonts, fluid hero type, or oversized marketing typography for labels, buttons, data, navigation, or form controls.

rules.name: The Thai Line-Height Rule
rules.body: text-sm is 22/14 in every language; Thai pages raise text-xs, text-xl, text-2xl and text-3xl to 18/12, 30/20, 36/24 and 44/30. A4 operation documents keep text-sm at 20/14 so the signature row stays on page 1.

rules.name: The Thai Readability Rule
rules.body: Thai and English labels must remain readable at operational density. Do not shrink helper text or placeholders below accessible contrast or touch usability.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: Use a border and tonal surface for grouping. Panels, cards, and the topbar are flat; only dialogs, sheets, popovers, and menus use shadow-overlay, over a bg-scrim backdrop.

rules.name: The No Floating Marketing Cards Rule
rules.body: Panels must not become decorative cards arranged for landing-page drama.

dos: Do preserve existing tokens and design-system helpers such as panel, action button, field control, table shell, mobile card list, empty state, and touch icon button classes.
Do keep navy #083161 for the logo and the selected menu row, Primary #1E4F94 for actions and links, and teal for info status, focus and the selected menu icon.
Do use borders and tonal layers as the grouping mechanism; use shadow-overlay only for dialogs, sheets, popovers and menus, and bg-scrim behind them.
Do keep tables and forms dense enough for enterprise scanning, but not cramped.
Do pair status colors with readable labels, marker shapes, icons, or explicit workflow context so status does not rely on color alone.

Do support Thai and English text, keyboard navigation, visible focus states, reduced motion, touch-safe mobile/tablet controls, and clear empty, loading, error, permission-denied, and validation states.
Do preserve business workflows, RBAC, locale routing, audit trail expectations, Prisma/SQL Server behavior, and production readiness assumptions.
donts: Don't use consumer-app styling, bright playful colors, heavy animation, marketing-style hero layouts, gamified UI, casual startup dashboards, decorative gradients, or anything that makes the system feel like a landing page instead of an enterprise operations tool.
Don't use glassmorphism, heavy shadows, decorative gradients, floating marketing cards, or playful surfaces.
Don't bring back a dark navy sidebar, a second focus color, or green, orange and red outside status badges.
Don't show database status colors on badges, or use teal brand-accent as text.
Don't redesign business workflows for visual effect.
Don't invent inconsistent button, input, modal, badge, or navigation vocabularies across screens.
Don't rely on color alone for status, permission, validation, audit, or lifecycle state.
Don't use display fonts, fluid hero typography, gradient text, oversized cards, or landing-page composition inside product workflows.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders as a decorative accent. Use full borders, status badges, text labels, and icons instead.
